verdict.rationale: Orama is a search engine, so inspecting ranking scores or explanations is a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers full-text, vector and hybrid search, facets, fields boosting and pinning rules, but never documents returned relevance scores or any score-explanation or debug output. Boosting and pinning are tuning controls, not ways to inspect why a result ranked where it did, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can inspect ranking scores or explanations to understand exactly why a result ranked where it did
